title: Myanmar’s Strongman President Is on a Global Quest for Legitimacy. Next Stop, Malaysia.
summary_full: After trading his military uniform for civilian clothes, Myanmar’s strongman president, U Min Aung Hlaing, is in Malaysia, his ninth stop on a search for international legitimacy.
